title: Image comparison study
intro: Thank you for helping! In this short study you compare images made by two image-generation methods. There are no right or wrong answers; we want your impression.
inst_pairs: Each question shows two images on each side of the screen. Each image was made from one of the two texts above them, marked ① and ②.
inst_highlight_a: The two texts differ only in the
inst_highlight_b: words, so on each side the two images should differ only there.
inst_answer: For each of three questions, choose the left side (◀), the right side (▶), or Tie:
inst_zoom: Tap any image to enlarge it.
inst_time: There are 25 questions, about 12 minutes in all. If you close the page, you can continue later on the same device.
inst_landscape: On a phone, please hold it sideways (landscape).
consent: I agree that my answers are recorded for research. My name will not be published.
quality_full: Which side's images look better? Think of how natural they look, and of visible seams, cut-off objects or other flaws.
alignment_full: Which side's images match their texts better? Check each image against its own text.
diversity_full: On which side do the two images differ more clearly in the highlighted parts?
connection: Connection problem. Please check your internet connection.
unsent: Some answers are still being sent. Please keep this page open for a moment.
more_lead: Have a few more minutes? You can answer more questions.
test_mode: Test mode: answers are not saved.
